(()=>{const out=[];const bb=new THREE.Box3(),ctr=new THREE.Vector3();const ids=(PT8.CARS||[]).map(c=>c.id).filter(Boolean);for(const id of ids){try{PT8.launch({mode:'mp',rally:true,circuit:true,track:15,laps:1,humans:[{id,alt:0}],ai:[]});RACE.state='race';const c=RACE.cars[0];for(let i=0;i<120;i++)step(1/60);updateVisual(c,RACE.T,2);c.m.g.updateMatrixWorld(true);const ws=c.m.ptWheels||[];let mn=1e9,mx=-1e9;for(const w of ws){bb.setFromObject(w.spin);bb.getCenter(ctr);const s=RACE.T.surf(ctr.x,ctr.z,c.y);const d=bb.min.y-s.h;mn=Math.min(mn,d);mx=Math.max(mx,d)}
const vb=new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(c.m.visualModel);const s0=RACE.T.surf(c.x,c.z,c.y);out.push([id,ws.length,+mn.toFixed(2),+mx.toFixed(2),+(vb.min.y-s0.h).toFixed(2)])}catch(e){out.push([id,String(e).slice(0,60)])}}return JSON.stringify({n:ids.length,out})})()
